attrs.note: GPT-5.6's CUDA-XOR case, and the best idea in its reply. An inherited `xor.cuda` that will not run on a CPU-only host is NOT a continuity violation — its guarantee was conditional and the assumption is undischarged. The violation would be reporting it available. This is STALE ≠ UNESTABLISHED, one domain over.
attrs.statement: A capability's continuity claim is conditional on a declared contract: the assumptions under which its guarantee holds. The claim is `assume A, guarantee G`, never `G`.
